findings.statement: Available primary candidate for institutional plans located in OneDrive: 11438 rows, 29 columns, 223 plans, 127 academic program/sede pairs, RE and CO; same schema and aggregate canonical metrics as old audit but different SHA-256.

Observed raw row grain is CODPESTUD+CODRAMO+NIVEL+RamoEquiv+RamoReq, allowing blank equivalence/prerequisite slots; 11438 distinct rows. Dropping expansion attributes yields 4854 groups. No dates/validity/SIES version fields.

Enrollment report has CODCLI/RUT/CODCARPR but no plan or MRUN; notes report has CODCLI/RUT/CODCARR/PLAN_DE_ESTUDIO and academic ANO/PERIODO. Exact current CODCLI intersection is 11075; 3969 current keys lack notes and 1993 notes keys lack current enrollment key. This is join availability only.

Notes contain 197 plan labels for 13068 CODCLI; each CODCLI has one observed plan. Course years 2019–2026 do not establish when plan assignment began/ended, and 4211 literal NULL academic keys are incomplete.

Technical 2026 closure and reusable governed join logic exist, but not a verified full-history inverse resolver. The 43-row result table and 223-plan canonical TSV are separately marked by actual availability.

No approved persisted MRUN↔RUT↔CODCLI identity crosswalk was located in the searched repositories/metadata. Documents explicitly separate UMAS RUT from SIES MRUN and describe diagnostics without definitive identity assignment. This is a scoped search finding, not proof of global nonexistence.

findings.statement: MU2026 consume puente compilado por JORNADA|CODCARPR|NOMBRE_L; fallback normaliza continuidad si no hay match exacto. Ambiguos pasan a cascada: condición de ingreso si existe, sede, plan esperado, jornada, homologación, carrera+jornada+versión.

El plan esperado es3 si CODCARPR empieza CI/CO/CA/CN, de otro modo1. Si versión no viene, la cascada usa máximo por carrera+jornada. Otro fallback posterior llena VERSION faltante desde ese mismo máximo. No usa año/cohorte para esos máximos.
findings.limit: Reglas implementadas, no una confirmación de validez histórica.

findings.statement: La ruta de control heredada usa matriz CODCARPR+jornada+versión construida de DURACION; fusionaJ3/J4enO, conserva primera ocurrencia si hay conflicto, y tomaVERSIONdePLAN_ESTUDIOS oV1 por defecto. No es la consulta anual estricta.
El resolvedor anual requiere año explícito; codcarpr+sede+jornada, con nombre/versión opcionales, o código completo. Asigna código solo con candidato único. No ofrece calendario histórico de aliases.
